'''Reject Alley''' was a [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[N'zoth]]. It was built within a rocky crevasse.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> It was home to the [[Yevetha]] who were outcast because of their shame.
